propositions: Users need an author-facing repair surface (CLI + library + MCP) to retroactively link commits to tickets via rebar-ticket trailer, with all-or-nothing SHA validation before recording COMMITS events.
A deterministic close gate must block if any discovered commit's changed paths are not declared in file_impact and do not match exemption globs (tests/**, docs/**, **/*.md, CHANGELOG.md).

The check must discover commits from two sources: explicit COMMITS events and source-control commits reachable from HEAD with rebar-ticket trailers, unioning file_impact over the same id set to avoid false blocks on parent tickets.
Merge commits and unreachable source-(i) SHAs must be skipped; source-(ii) local commits must fail closed on git errors, and the check must not import rebar.llm.
Path matching must use **/–aware glob semantics centralized in src/rebar/_engine_support/commit_impact.py, replacing duplicate implementations in prompts.py and registry.py.
Generated docs (cli-reference.md, mcp-reference.md) must regenerate cleanly with the new attach-commits verb and attach_commits MCP tool.
